batch.description: Progress of a batch generation started by POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/flow-suggestions/batch-generate: per-journey events, then the run's end. On connect the server replays the last event of every journey that reported (request order), then the end frame if the run has ended; the socket stays open. No credentials are presented.

describe.description: Streams one scenario-from-description run: progress, split approval, timeline, re-drives and its terminal outcome; accepts run controls. After accept the first frame replays state: redrive_started (finished run being re-driven), else the terminal frame (complete/error/cancelled/interrupted), else split_proposal (parked on approval), else drive_snapshot (drive under way), else nothing. The socket stays open after terminal frames. Before accept: Origin must equal the Host (same scheme default port); principal must be a project member with at least viewer role (an API token pinned to another project is refused); the run must be the principal's own. A refused handshake closes before accept (the server answers HTTP 403; browsers report 1006). Credentials: API token or signed session token in Authorization: Bearer, session cookie, or a signed session token in ?token= (never an API token).

project_id.description: Project id; the principal must be a member with viewer role or higher.

run_id.description: Scenario-from-description run id; must be the principal's own run in this project.

describe.title: Scenario-from-description run

A refused handshake closes before accept (the server answers HTTP 403; browsers report 1006). Credentials: session cookie (or a signed session token in Authorization: Bearer); API tokens and any ?token= query parameter are refused.
